primary_task: Import a SARIF (or weAudit/binary graph) results file into a Trailmark code graph for the target directory and report matched findings and severity subgraphs.

requirements.name: trailmark (via uv)
requirements.evidence: **MANDATORY:** If `uv run trailmark` fails, install trailmark first: `uv tool install trailmark`
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...); uv is obtainable from PyPI; that trailmark is published there is not stated by the manifest

requirements.name: python (uv run --with trailmark python)
requirements.evidence: Python snippets: uv run --with trailmark python -
requirements.basis: bash: run CLIs and scripts on Linux x86_64

requirements.name: SARIF / weAudit / binary graph input file
requirements.basis: grants: local_filesystem; the manifest does not say the results file is in the working directory

requirements.name: target source directory
requirements.basis: grants: local_filesystem; repository presence not stated

requirements.name: semgrep / codeql
requirements.evidence: Running static analysis tools (use semgrep/codeql directly, then import)
requirements.basis: bash: pip from PyPI and GitHub release downloads are open; listed under When NOT to Use, not part of the primary task

notes: Taken as installable assuming uv and trailmark are on PyPI; if trailmark were not on PyPI the hard requirement would be unavailable and the verdict BLOCKED. Follow-ups (trailmark-finding-triage, diagramming) excluded.
